pages.useful_because: The homepage is the only page that puts all five Ledco Plumbing services side by side with a symptom guide that matches what a Seminole homeowner is actually seeing (one slow drain, several drains backing up, a jumping water bill, a split pipe after a hard freeze, a rumbling water heater) to the service that fixes it. It also names the owner, Mickey Ledbetter, shows the 316 E Oak Ave office on a map with directions, explains what to do in the first minutes of a leak (close the main shutoff), and walks through what happens after the estimate form is sent. Service pages go deep on one problem each; this page routes the visitor to the right one.
